# braintrust_project_tag (Resource)

Manages a Braintrust project tag. Tags are user-configured labels for tracking and filtering experiments, logs, and other data within a project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "braintrust_project" "my_project" {
  name = "my-project"
}

# Create a project tag for labeling experiments.
resource "braintrust_project_tag" "correctness" {
  project_id  = braintrust_project.my_project.id
  name        = "correctness"
  description = "Marks experiments focused on correctness evaluation"
  color       = "#4CAF50"
}

# A simple tag with just a name and color.
resource "braintrust_project_tag" "staging" {
  project_id = braintrust_project.my_project.id
  name       = "staging"
  color      = "#FF9800"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the project tag.
- `project_id` (String) Unique identifier for the project that the tag belongs to.

### Optional

- `color` (String) Color of the tag for the UI.
- `description` (String) Textual description of the project tag.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date of project tag creation.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the project tag (UUID).
- `user_id` (String) Identifies the user who created the project tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the project tag ID.
terraform import braintrust_project_tag.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
